subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Do Mattermost owners accept one ten-second-bounded server thread read per recovered stored session and select this PR over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 as the canonical implementation?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but green CI cannot choose between duplicate long-lived implementations or approve the intentional first-recovery latency budget.
